intro: Training the Beast is the culminating rite of passage for young dwarven hunters in Dun Morogh. Having mastered the art of soothing and taming wild predators in the snowy crags, novice rangers are directed into the heart of Ironforge to learn how to sustain, discipline, and care for a lifelong animal companion.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Friend, ya now have the power to tame a pet, but you must also gain the skills ta train it.

Travel to Ironforge and find the Hall of Arms. There you must speak to one of our most revered animal trainers, Belia Thundergranite. She'll give ya the power to train your new pet, so get goin', friend!
Belia is a friendly sort; you should have no problems gaining her approval. Good luck, friend.

clips.title: Completion
paras: A new recruit, eh? You're on your way to becoming a great adventurer, I see.

Yes, I can bestow you with the skills you need to train and guide your pet. Not only will you be able to teach your pet new abilities, you will now be able to feed your pet, as well as revive it, should it fall in battle.
Remember that the key to getting the most from your new pet is to respect it and treat it well. In turn, your pet will be your most loyal friend.
